text:
sara: Kicking off a mini playbook thread for the launch pages + social + webinar routing. Goal: crisp site copy for Hosted/Dedicated/Private, 2 hero variants per mode, three social snippets (short/medium/thread), and routing rules for inbound leads. Can we finalize by tomorrow noon?
ben: I'm on the hero microcopy. Trying two tones: "outcome-first" and "engineer-friendly". Will post both.
li: please include explicit microcopy for form labels and the checkbox text. Small UX matters a lot for conversion.
nate: routing ops: propose these hidden fields: `lead_mode`, `promo_code`, `utm_launch`. Map `lead_mode=hosted` -> hosted_trial queue; `lead_mode=dedicated|private` -> enterprise_engage. Also add `consult_checkbox=true` -> tag high_touch.
marta: benchmarking note for blog/social: keep headlines metric-led, e.g., "3.6x throughput on sustained traffic" then a one-line methodology (seq len, hardware). We'll link to a methodology anchor.
sara: social snippets: short (X feed): "Ship LLM features with predictable cost & latency — Redwood Inference. Try hosted free." Medium (LinkedIn): 1-sentence value, 2 bullets w/metric, CTA. Thread: expand with microcase & link to benchmark.
ben: hero drafts:
1) Outcome-first (hosted): H1: "Ship LLM features, skip the infra." H2: "Hosted API with predictable latency and per-token pricing." CTA: "Try Hosted"
2) Engineer-friendly (hosted): H1: "Low-latency streaming, SDKs you actually use." H2: "One API to test, run, and scale models." CTA: "Get Hosted Credits"
(Dedicated) Outcome: H1: "Predictable capacity for production ML" H2: "Reserved GPU pools, SLA, autoscale policies." CTA: "Request Capacity"
(Private) Outcome: H1: "Private inference in your network" H2: "VPC, KMS, and audit-grade controls." CTA: "Talk to Sales"
li: prefer shorter CTAs: "Try Hosted", "Request Capacity", "Talk to Sales" — keep the verbs consistent. Also suggest micro-CTA under bullets: "See benchmark".
nate: form & routing snippets to hand to eng: ```
POST /lead-capture
payload: { name, email, company, lead_mode, consult_checkbox, utm_campaign }
rules: if payload.lead_mode == "hosted" -> assign_queue: "hosted_trial"; else assign_queue: "enterprise_engage"; if payload.consult_checkbox == true -> tag: "high_touch"
```
marta: social schedule: 1) Launch day primer (short X + LI) 2) Bench thread day 2 (deep thread with microcases) 3) Webinar invite day 4. We'll include tracking tags: utm_campaign=launch-q2, utm_content=bench-thread.
sara: webinar landing copy ask: 1-line benefit + 3 takeaways + speaker bullet. Example: Benefit: "How to reduce inference cost without sacrificing latency." Takeaways: (1) architecture patterns; (2) batching & cache tactics; (3) routing and rollback strategies. Checkbox: "I want a capacity consult" -> set lead_mode.
ben: A/B plan: Variant A uses metric-first hero (e.g., "4x cheaper per token") Variant B uses product-first hero (e.g., "Hosted API, streaming responses"). Run for 2 weeks, primary metric = form CTR -> signups. Secondary = demo requests.
li: microcopy list (for dev): form field labels and placeholder suggestions: "Company (optional)", "Workload type (dropdown)", "Estimated monthly tokens (optional)", checkbox label: "Yes, I'd like a capacity consult (I understand a rep may reach out)". Hidden field values: `lead_source=web_launch`, `lead_mode` as above.
nate: deploy-bot: preflight checklist for eng infra: 1) staging page up 2) forms wired 3) SFDC queues exist 4) tracking pixels in place 5) redirect rules for CTA.
deploy-bot: pages-deploy: scheduled staging deploy 2026-06-09T18:00Z; hold until copy approved.
marta: benchmark card copy (short): "Latency-first: 25ms median tail; Batch embeddings: 2.8x throughput vs baseline; Regulated: air-gapped deploys with full audit logs." Will create an SVG card for each.
sara: drafting three social variants now. Posting them here for review: short X: "Redwood Inference: predictable latency, lower unit cost. Try Hosted." medium LI: "Why production inference is the new core competency. Join our webinar to see microbenchmarks and real config examples. Register -> link." thread first tweet: "Benchmarked: 3 scenarios where serving choices change cost/latency tradeoffs. Thread ->"
ben: pushing hero comps to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh/launch-web-copy-variants
li: uploading microcopy doc to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-copy/microcopy-v1.docx
nate: SFDC queues confirmed: hosted_trial, enterprise_engage. Also added automation: if company_size >= 500 and estimated_monthly_tokens > 50000000 -> set predicted_arr = high -> assign to enterprise_engage + notify_sdr = true.
sara: timeline recap: by tomorrow noon: - Ben finalize hero variants - Li finalize microcopy + form labels - Marta final benchmark cards and short methodology - Nate wire routing + SFDC - I'll finish social drafts and webinar outline. Tag me when complete.
ben: noted, publishing a1/a2 copy to staging shortly. staging url (mock): https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-variant-a
li: microcopy uploaded and shared with design.
marta: benchmark artifacts in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-visuals (comments open)
nate: routing snippets and sample webhook posted in internal docs: https://wiki.redwood.ai/launch-routing (mock)
sara: thanks team. Once everything is in staging I'll do a quick UX sweep and then we burn the deploy-bot hold. :sparkles: 
deploy-bot: social-posts-scheduler: queued 2026-06-10 09:30 UTC; awaiting manual release.
